data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 gross claims outstanding were GBP 80.5m. The syndicate recorded a small favourable prior-year movement of approximately GBP 0.8m (a release) predominantly reflecting favourable claims development on older underwriting years (principally 2018). Overall gross claims outstanding increased to GBP 89.8m at 31 December 2020 driven by current year claims development. The syndicate writes predominantly short-tail property-catastrophe business and the RDS scenario table is used to assess catastrophe exposure.
raw_causal_phrases: Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.
The provision for claims in Syndicate 1910 comprises amounts set aside for claims notified and claims incurred, but not yet reported (IBNR).
The amount included in respect of IBNR in Syndicate 1910 is based on statistical techniques of estimation applied by external consulting actuaries.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount was not stated explicitly as a gross single-line figure; it was derived from the gross claims development table (triangle) by comparing the 2018 column current estimate to its prior diagonal (release of GBP 0.8m). No explicit narrative sentence quantifying gross prior year movement was found. The syndicate operates as a funds withheld quota share; amounts are presented as Syndicate 6117 share. RITC activity noted elsewhere (2018 year closed into 2019) may affect interpretations of older year movements but does not appear to distort the 2018 column used here.
